# InvoiceGenerator.ng

> Free online invoice generator for Nigerian businesses — create professional Naira invoices, send via WhatsApp, collect payments via Paystack, and stay FIRS/VAT compliant. No sign-up required for basic use.

InvoiceGenerator.ng is Nigeria's leading free online invoice generator, built specifically for Nigerian freelancers, sole traders, SMEs, and service businesses. It supports Nigerian Naira (₦), applies 7.5% VAT automatically, integrates with Paystack for online payment collection, and sends invoices directly to clients via WhatsApp — matching how Nigerian businesses actually operate.

## Core Product Pages

- [Free Invoice Generator](https://www.invoicegenerator.ng/): Create professional invoices instantly, download as PDF, share via WhatsApp — no sign-up required
- [AI Invoice Generator](https://www.invoicegenerator.ng/invoice-generator-ai): Describe your work in plain English and the AI creates a complete invoice instantly
- [Invoice Generator for Nigeria](https://www.invoicegenerator.ng/invoice-generator-nigeria): Nigeria-specific features including VAT, TIN, and FIRS compliance
- [Naira Invoice Generator](https://www.invoicegenerator.ng/naira-invoice-generator): Create invoices denominated in Nigerian Naira (₦/NGN)
- [Free Receipt Generator Nigeria](https://www.invoicegenerator.ng/free-receipt-generator): Create professional payment receipts for Nigerian businesses
- [Freelance Invoice Template NGN](https://www.invoicegenerator.ng/freelance-invoice-template-ngn): Invoice templates for Nigerian freelancers and contractors

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- **Free to use**: No watermarks, no sign-up required for basic invoice creation and PDF download
- **Currency**: Nigerian Naira (₦/NGN) as default; also supports USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD
- **VAT rate**: 7.5% (Nigeria Tax Act 2025, formerly Finance Act; charged by VAT-registered businesses)
- **VAT registration threshold**: ₦25 million annual taxable turnover (mandatory); voluntary registration available below this
- **E-invoicing**: Nigeria is rolling out mandatory e-invoicing. Phase 1 applies to businesses with turnover above ₦500 million from Q1 2026. Small businesses are exempt until later phases.
- **Tax authority**: Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) — previously Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS), renamed under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025
- **Withholding Tax (WHT)**: 5% for individuals, 10% for companies, on service invoices. Exemption applies to invoices below ₦2 million where the recipient provides a valid TIN.
- **Payment integration**: Paystack (Nigeria's leading payment gateway), PayPal, Stripe
- **WhatsApp delivery**: Sends invoice PDFs directly to any WhatsApp number via Twilio or Meta Business API
- **Recurring invoices**: Automated recurring invoice generation for retainer clients
- **Invoice formats**: Professional PDF with logo, multiple templates, QR code payment links
